nodes.natural_language: f satisfies f(1)=2, f(n)=f(n-1)+1 for even n, and f(n)=f(n-2)+2 for odd n>1
nodes.statement: forall n, the recursive clauses hold

nodes.natural_language: instantiate the closed form at n=2017 to obtain f(2017)=2018
The claimed closed form holds for the base cases n=1 and n=2.
The closed form therefore holds for every positive integer n.
nodes.statement: forall n in positive integers, f(n)=n+1

nodes.natural_language: If n is even and the closed form holds at n-1, then it holds at n.
If n is even then f(n)=f(n-1)+1=(n-1)+1+1=n+1
nodes.statement: forall even n, (f(k)=k+1 for all k<n) => f(n)=n+1

nodes.natural_language: If n is odd and n>1 then f(n)=f(n-2)+2=(n-2)+1+2=n+1
nodes.statement: forall odd n>1, (f(k)=k+1 for all k<n) => f(n)=n+1
